title: Camera Coverage
description: Professional coverage strategy: capturing enough complementary angles and sizes to cut a scene with continuity and emphasis.
summary: Camera coverage is the deliberate set of angles and shot sizes recorded for a scene so editors can maintain continuity, control emphasis, and solve performance or timing issues.
